site.sitedescription: Lake Selina occupies a small basin eroded in Ordovician Owen Conglomerate that forms the West Coast Range. The conglomerates have produced acid, nutrient-deficient, podzol and peaty podzol soils onthe slopes, and peat on the poorly drained floor of the basin.
